name: Falling Leaves
qol: Configurable leaf size, lifespan, spawn rate, wind, and per-block settings via Mod Menu (Cloth Config)
getting_started: Stand under or near a tree. Conifer, jungle-type large-leaf trees and shrubs do not drop leaves by default; raise their spawn rate in settings if desired.
editor_notes: Client only. Jar is named for 26.1 (fallingleaves-2.0.7+26.1) but listed for the 26.2 pack; verify it loads.
summary: Adds a particle effect where leaf blocks shed falling leaves. Works with modded trees and resource packs; configurable spawn rates per leaf type.
